data.body: **[P2] Add automated runtime coverage for the React 19 upgrade.** The existing CI only installs, typechecks, and bundles this renderer, while the extension's Jest configuration explicitly excludes `webview-ui`. Those checks cannot catch React 19 runtime incompatibilities in `createRoot` or Cloudscape interactions, so a blank or interaction-broken webview could pass CI. Add a renderer smoke test that mounts the app with the upgraded runtime, exercises representative modal/table/control interactions, and run it in the `insight-hosts` job.
